title: How long until you see muscle? ⏳
caption:
Strength jumps first, from your nervous system. Scans can find real growth after about 3-4 weeks, and a visible change usually takes a couple of months of hard training, enough protein and sleep. Take photos every 4 weeks. How long have you been training? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 17
first_comment: Month 1 me vs now me. Who has progress pics? 📸
